lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment
lots.description: ESPO Framework 107_26 is a single national multi-supplier framework agreement for the provision of inspection & maintenance (and associated remedial) services covering indoor gymnasium equipment, fitness equipment, sports equipment and outdoor schools play & sport equipment. The framework covers the nine English regions (East Midlands, East of England, London, North East, North West, South East, South West, West Midlands, Yorkshire and Humber) with optional coverage of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Framework term is approximately 19 months initial (24 June 2026 - 31 January 2028) with an option to extend up to 23 June 2030 (max 4 years total). Estimated value is £10m over the maximum term. A minimum of 4 Suppliers is anticipated and all Tenderers must be able to supply all nine English regions.
requirements: Provide inspection & maintenance services for indoor gymnasium equipment, fitness equipment, sports equipment, and outdoor schools play & sport equipment, plus associated remedial services.
Suppliers must be able to supply all nine English regions as a baseline; optional coverage of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland may be declared.
Inspection, maintenance and/or remedial visits must be pre-arranged with the Customer, with a minimum of one visit per annum.

Each inspection & maintenance visit must include a full inspection of all portable and fixed physical education and fitness equipment as required by the Customer, plus routine maintenance (e.g. tightening of nuts and bolts), replacement of sundry items (e.g. washers), and lubrication of moving parts.
Following the first inspection & maintenance visit, the Supplier must submit a written report to the Customer detailing maintenance work carried out and any remedial work required.
Any item of equipment considered unsafe or not constructed to required safety standards must be clearly flagged in the inspection & maintenance report.

The Supplier must provide all necessary access equipment (e.g. ladders, scaffolding) to enable examination of overhead trackway, climbing ropes, travelling beam uprights etc., and comply with all health and safety requirements.

Remedial work must not be carried out until an official quotation has been considered, approved and confirmed by the Customer (unless it can be done within the initial visit under an agreed quotation process).
Where agreed with the Customer, emergency call outs may be provided for unforeseen breakages or damage.
Tenderers must provide pricing for a minimum of 40 out of the 57 service requirements (70%) in the Pricing Schedule (Appendix B); failure to price at least 40/57 excludes the bid from evaluation.

Tendered pricing must be inclusive of travel, inspection & maintenance and reports; remedial work is priced separately. All pricing must be exclusive of VAT but inclusive of the 3.5% ESPO framework fee.
Awarded Suppliers may not increase their tendered rates for a period of at least 12 months from the Framework's commencement date.
The Supplier pays a Framework Fee of 3.5% of total turnover of business conducted under the Framework, payable quarterly.
The Supplier must provide quarterly management information in the format specified in clause 15 and schedule 7 of the Framework Agreement.
Variant bids will not be accepted.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Price accounts for 40% of the total Tender score, evaluated against the Pricing Schedule (Appendix B). Pricing is evaluated on a 'basket' total using median-price scoring: the median total basket price receives half of available points (20), and other Tenderers score pro-rata relative to the median, subject to a minimum of zero.
Non-price accounts for 60% of the total Tender score across six questions (Q1-Q6). Quality questions are scored 0-3 and weighted, then totalled and expressed as a percentage of 60%.

product_requirements.summary: Counter Balanced Beams (Fixed and Hinged): inspect, tighten, adjust fixings and fittings; inspect/adjust/replace wires, weights, booms, boom swivels, hauling/tricing lines, wedges, cords, tracks, floor plates, pulleys, uprights, wheeling.
Fixed Tubular Equipment: inspect, tighten, adjust fixings; lubricate tracks; replace broken spacing chains; inspect/replace hauling/tricing lines, floor plates, pole end fittings, pulleys, wheels.
Hinged Frames: inspect fixings, wires, tensioning device; free/lubricate pulleys; replace worn parts.
Rope Tracks / Rope Frames / Ropes: inspect and maintain fixings, tracks, tricing/hauling lines, pulleys, spacing chains, cleats, ropes, rope ladders, trapeze/rings.
Fixed and Hinged Wall Bars: inspect/tighten/replace screws, bolts, wall fixings, securing brackets, floor fittings; supply and fit new oval mouldings; clean off splinters and re-varnish where needed.

Basketball Goals: inspect/tighten fixings, framework, tension wires, tensioning device, hand winch, electric winch (motor + limit switches + gearbox oil + brake unit, excluding Electricity at Work Act testing), lifting cable, pulleys, backboard, ring & net.

Trackway and Netting (Divisional / Cricket): check operation for snagging joints; inspect/tighten track fixings; replace up to 3 trolleys if worn; inspect/re-hang nets, hauling lines, pulleys, storage bags and straps.
Floor Sockets: inspect/clean/tighten/re-thread threaded type; clean socket type; inspect/clean/tighten/lubricate flip-up type.
Vaulting Equipment (Boxes / Horses / Bucks): inspect/tighten/replace fixings; clean/touch-in varnish woodwork; replace rubber feet, wheeling gear wheels; inspect/patch hide covers.

Upholstered Equipment (Stools / Benches / Tables): inspect/tighten fixings; inspect woodwork/metalwork for splinters and cracked welds; replace rubber feet; inspect safety devices, cracked welds, padded tops; recover with new PVC where damage is fair wear and tear.
Springboards: inspect/tighten/replace fixings; remove splinters and touch-in varnish; check for delamination of plywood components; inspect/replace rubber feet.
Balance Benches and Planks: inspect/tighten/replace fixings; remove splinters, re-varnish if necessary; replace rubber feet, hooks, bench buttons; inspect staunton bars and angle brackets.

Trestles / Poles / Ladders / Bars: inspect/tighten/replace fixings; inspect woodwork for splinters and re-varnish; inspect metalwork for cracked welds; replace worn rubber feet, grommets/brushes, plastic tube inserts; inspect safety devices and threaded hooks; repair rubber/leather hook covers.

Landing Mats and Agility Mattresses: minor repairs to render safe for further use; inspect perished rubber bases; replace (do not repair) mats with ripped/worn-through covers (afPE guidance; patching causes trip hazards and fails fire regulations); safety mattress covers can be replaced but foam condition and mattress age must be considered. Cleaning and re-covering of agility mattresses is out of scope.

Games Posts and Goals (Indoor): inspect/tighten/replace fixings; inspect framework parts for cracked welds and damage; lubricate hinges; inspect safety devices; inspect/free wheels and wheeling devices; inspect/replace rubber feet; inspect anchorage points for security.
Equipment Trolleys: inspect/tighten/replace fixings; inspect framework parts for cracked welds; inspect platform; free and clean castors and wheels.
Wall Storage: inspect/tighten/replace fixings; inspect brackets/hooks and covers for wear; re-glue or recover covers if practical (excludes re-coating in plastic).

Trampettes: full maintenance including on-site frame welding. Replacement of bed, cables/springs or frame safety pads is subject to a separate order; fitting of such replacements on a subsequent visit must be included in the Framework visit cost.

Trampolines: inspect equipment, check and adjust where necessary and report. Price includes all labour charges plus fitting of sundry spare parts. Major replacement (e.g. new bed) requires official customer order before execution.
Climbing Walls: inspect all fixings for security and good working order; inspect the material of the wall itself for wear and damage.

Cardiovascular and Strength Equipment: inspect as required by Customer. Complete on-site service report and service certificate. Service all makes (electronic and manual). Parts available for supply only and supply-and-fit. On-site upholstery and stitched covers capability. Cardiovascular service covers, belts/chains, rollers, bearings, display, hinge points, general clean. Resistance machine service covers frames, guide rods, wires/belts, upholstery, plungers, rubbers, weight stacks, pulleys, handles/clips, selector keys, general clean.

Outdoor schools fixed playground equipment, low-level and low-risk inspection of trim trail equipment, activity play equipment and surfacing equipment as typically found in schools (e.g. trim trails). Outdoor inspections are actioned during same visit as indoor inspections.

warnings.message: Tender document describes a single national framework (ESPO 107_26) covering all 9 English regions with all suppliers required to supply all regions. No explicit lot-split (regional or categorical) is present in the document. The extraction therefore emits a single lot with lot_number='1'. Pricing Schedule (Appendix B) contains 57 service requirements but those are priced items within a single framework, not separate lots.

CPV codes (37400000 Sports goods and equipment; 50000000 Repair and maintenance services) were not observed verbatim in the tender specification markdown; they are carried from the notice-level process_context signals. Document itself describes the scope qualitatively ('inspection & maintenance of indoor gymnasium, fitness & sport equipment and outdoor schools play & sport equipment') without citing CPV numerics.

The 57 individual service requirements and their unit-of-measure, rate bands and Remedial Work pricing are contained in Appendix B (Pricing Schedule) which is a separate document (pdf-extraction/pricing-schedule overlay). This payload only captures the 21 equipment categories described in Section 2 (Requirement) plus two outdoor scopes called out earlier; per-row pricing lines are not duplicated here.
